marta-peopleops: Quick thread  David submitted an off-cycle promotion + comp change for Noor, asking for 2026-03-01 effective with retro. Can we do retro given payroll cutoff?

david-eng-manager: Yes, effective 3/1. Title: SWE II -> SWE III, base from $110,000 -> $125,000. Uploaded manager evidence and org lead sign-off. Prefer correction so employee gets cash ASAP.

marta-peopleops: FYI payroll cutoff is the 20th at 23:59 UTC. If we miss that we do a retro correction on next run (separate line). Also need a 1-line leveling rationale for audit and comp committee note for equity band change.

jen-payroll: Confirmed cutoff. If you want correction pushed through next run, submit retro form and attach docs. Correction will include tax adjustments and update YTD. If you want it included as regular base pay (no correction), need to wait until next pay cycle and set effective date then.

david-eng-manager: We'll take correction. Anything else?

marta-peopleops: Two quick asks: 1) paste a single-line rationale here; 2) confirm if equity refresh should be immediate or deferred to next grant cycle.

david-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promoted for consistent execution on infra latency projects and mentoring across squads." Defer equity to next grant.

maya-recruiter: For banding: I'll ping comp ops for sizing confirmation. They usually respond within 2 business days. No blocker for salary change.

comp-committee-bot: Reminder: if banding changes, comp committee needs leveling memo + recent calibration snapshot. Submit via https://internal.tools/comp-requests.

jen-payroll: Please submit retro form here: https://internal.forms/retro-us and use code RETRO-ENG-2026. Attach evidence and org sign-off. Once we have the form ID I'll create ticket PAY-2026-491 and attach to employee record.

marta-peopleops: Action items recap: David -> paste rationale (done) and upload docs (done). Maya -> ping comp ops (in flight). Jen -> create payroll ticket after form ID. We'll close when payroll posts.

david-eng-manager: Uploaded form ID RETRO-2325. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jen-payroll: Got RETRO-2325. Created ticket PAY-2026-491. ETA 3 business days. Note: retro correction will hit YTD and require ledger reconciliation. Finance will be notified.

marta-peopleops: Noting in employee file. If comp ops requests anything else, I'll update here. Reopen thread if exceptions.
